goal: Register the selected portable artifact contracts, adopt arch-model@2 compatibly, and prevent duplicate architecture nodes during discovery.
architecture: Keep version identity and embedded schema validation in wisp-schema, with the existing immutable arch-model@1 validator retained for explicit callers. Make wisp-artifacts discover the shared architecture path once with arch-model@2, without migrating or writing its source document; leave CLI persistence spec-only.

tasks.title: Make the Git status fixture independent of global signing
steps: Add `-c commit.gpgsign=false` to the fixture-only Git commit command in status_reports_clean_after_the_canonical_file_is_committed; do not change repository or user Git configuration.
Run `cargo test --offline -p wisp-cli --test cli status_reports_clean_after_the_canonical_file_is_committed`; expect the test to pass without invoking GPG.
tasks.commit_message: test(cli): make fixture commits independent of signing

tasks.title: Vendor arch-model@2 with immutable provenance
steps: Copy shared/schemas/arch-model@2.json byte-for-byte from agent-plugins revision 6b49c245e6889b3971c7f7af77819913296c464a; do not alter schemas/arch-model@1.json.
Add the source repository, path, immutable revision, schema ID, and the calculated SHA-256 to schemas/PROVENANCE.md.
Run `jq -e '."$id" == "arch-model@2"' schemas/arch-model@2.json`; expect `true`.
Run `shasum -a 256 schemas/arch-model@2.json`; expect `9a2412cb088a2a43ac5caa35a853de59e163d939c579cf6929c00b3efa1c7da5` and the same value in the provenance record.

tasks.title: Register contracts and typed validation errors
steps: Add Contract::ArchModelV2 with ID arch-model@2 and canonical directory docs/architecture; embed schemas/arch-model@2.json with include_str! while retaining ArchModelV1 and its exact validator.
Add Contract::from_id and ContractLookupError::UnknownContract for exact registered IDs; unknown IDs return the typed error without filesystem access.
Make schema-violation diagnostics report the selected contract ID; preserve existing spec@1 validation behavior and error classification.
Add a dev-only SHA-256 check that compares all six embedded schema byte digests with their contract-specific records in schemas/PROVENANCE.md.

Add table-driven tests for every contract variant's exact schema ID, canonical directory, valid document, and provenance digest; test old-shape and decision_ref arch-model@2 documents, non-string decision_ref rejection, unknown-ID rejection, and contract-specific violation messages.
Run `cargo test --offline -p wisp-schema`; expect all wisp-schema unit tests to pass.

tasks.title: Discover architecture models once with the preferred validator
steps: Change graph discovery to scan docs/architecture once using ArchModelV2 while keeping ArchModelV1 available through explicit validation.

Add tests proving an @1-shaped model is returned once as ArchModelV2 without byte changes, an @2 decision_ref model is returned once, and invalid JSON/schema produces one workspace-relative document GraphIssue while independent artifacts remain discoverable.
Add a temporary-Git-worktree assertion that validation and graph discovery leave canonical bytes and `git status --porcelain` unchanged.
Run `cargo test --offline -p wisp-artifacts`; expect all artifact tests to pass.

tasks.title: Document the active schema registry and run workspace checks
steps: Update the current-registry description to list arch-model@1 and arch-model@2, distinguish explicit @1 validation from preferred @2 discovery, and preserve the spec-only persistence statement.

Run `git diff --check`; expect no whitespace errors. Record that `cargo fmt --all --check` fails on pre-existing formatting differences across untouched files; do not reformat unrelated source as part of this change.
Run `cargo test --offline --workspace`; expect every unit, CLI, and fixture test to pass.
Run `cargo clippy --offline --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`; expect no warnings or errors.
Recompute every digest listed in schemas/PROVENANCE.md; expect each value to match its vendored schema bytes.
